purpose: First real 892 temporal prototype after user broadened mandatory blur to cigarette, held fingers, smoke and mouth.

implementation.cigarette: 13 real SAM2 6fps mask shapes tracked between reference points to each of 60 output frames with dilation, no new GPU model inference
implementation.grip: Manual sample-specific moving ellipse; not generalized hand detector
implementation.smoke: Manual sample-specific window smoke and lower-face exhale local regions; opacity feathering; not generalized smoke detector
implementation.mouth: Manual sample-specific mouth ROI after exhale starts and cigarette approaches; not face landmark detector
implementation.initial_preview_visual_defect: Exhaled smoke outside mask and recognizable cigarette parts on some frames; conservative local zone widening applied.
implementation.remaining_risk: No human ground truth; exact cigarette coverage and smoke/mouth hand exclusivity unmeasured

includes: nine real unchanged negative 886_5 sampled frames

next: Replace manually positioned grip smoke mouth with independently validated moving ROI detection.
Label original real 892 frames to measure full smoking-event suppression at 30fps, including smoke away from tip.
Run candidate system on real 886_5 multi-frame negative microphone sequence before release.
Staged integration only after all acceptance checks, no production audio or XML edits.
